title: Pure Machina
summary: Pure Machina beatdown and control deck, utilizing generic Machine Link and Xyz support. Machinas are EARTH and DARK Machines centered around high-Level boss recursion, self-destruction combos, and graveyard-fueled power plays.

summary.title: Starters
points: Machina Redeployment discards a card (or a Machina card) to search two Machina cards with different names from your Deck.
Machina Gearframe adds any Machina monster from Deck to hand on Normal Summon, and can equip itself to a Machine for destruction protection.
Machina Unclaspare Special Summons itself from hand when added to hand (except by drawing) and sends a Machina monster from Deck to the GY, locking your Special Summons to Machines.
Machina Metalcruncher can be Normal Summoned without Tributes if you control no cards, revealing three EARTH Machines from Deck for the opponent to randomly add one to your hand.

summary.title: Opening: Machina Redeployment + Discard
steps: Activate Machina Redeployment, discarding a Machina card to search Machina Gearframe and Machina Unclaspare from your Deck.
Normal Summon Machina Gearframe to search Machina Fortress (or Machina Ruinforce) from Deck to hand.
Special Summon Machina Unclaspare with its own effect, triggering on summon to send Machina Citadel directly from Deck to the GY.
Link Summon Qliphort Genius using Machina Gearframe and Machina Unclaspare.
Discard Machine monsters totaling Level 8 or more to Special Summon Machina Fortress from hand or GY, placing a heavy threat next to Citadel's graveyard trigger.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Machina Citadel targets a Machine you control as a Quick Effect to destroy it and destroy all face-up monsters your opponent controls with equal or lower ATK; it revives itself from the GY whenever a face-up EARTH Machine you control is destroyed.

Machina Ruinforce summons itself from the GY by banishing Machines whose total Levels equal 12 or more, negates any activated card or effect during the Battle Phase by halving your LP, and floats into up to three banished Level 9 or lower Machinas if destroyed.

Machina Fortress summons itself by discarding Machine monsters totaling Level 8 or more, destroys a card on the field if destroyed by battle, and strips a card from the opponent's hand if targeted by a monster effect.
Machina Air Raider and Machina Irradiator discard a Machina to summon themselves, then destroy a Machine you control to summon another Machina from the Deck or GY.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Machina Redeployment sets up the hand and GY simultaneously by searching two engine cards at once.

Machina Overdrive targets a Machine you control to destroy it and Special Summon a Machina with a different name from the hand or Deck; it also banishes itself from the GY to recycle three Machines and draw a card.
Unauthorized Reactivation equips a Machine Union monster directly from the hand or Deck to a Machine on your field for instant protection or search setup.
Machina Defense Perimeter redirects opponent attacks away from Level 6 or lower Machines and recovers a Machine from the GY when an EARTH Machine is destroyed.
